episode_summary: In this episode, Vija Williams discusses the changing role of real estate agents in a post-AI world, emphasizing the importance of reaching sellers before they contact an agent. She highlights the use of cash offer leads as a strategy for agents to adapt to new consumer behaviors and offers insights into training agents to handle these leads effectively.
